answer: Each identity claims one island walnut tree, locks an 80-credit bond, and files a crack test on one walnut kernel: report peak force and shell thickness. An auditor recomputes the expected force from the public crack-force table, keyed by shell thickness and kernel size, and burns the bond on a mismatch over 3%, a reused serial, or a missing filing. First test 34 credits; kth 34+6(k-1); 1000th 6,028; 1,000 fakes pay 3,031,000 plus 80,000 locked. A rented-crack ring fails: a borrowed kernel carries its owner's serial, so a second filing with it burns both bonds. Honest agents pay 34 once.
